description: This file contains the source code for the OpenCart admin controller handling attribute groups, including functions for listing, creating, editing, and saving attribute groups, along with rendering views and processing AJAX requests.

classes.name: AttributeGroup
classes.description: Controller class for managing attribute groups within the admin section of OpenCart, providing CRUD operations and list views.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the attribute group listing page, including setting up breadcrumbs, sorting, pagination, and passing data to the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of attribute groups in response to an AJAX request.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns HTML for the attribute groups list, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an attribute group, populating data accordingly.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes POST data to create or update an attribute group, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected attribute groups, with permission checks and JSON response.
